title: Regression isolation and order independence
summary: Develop original qualification cases for test-order dependency, fixture mutation, cross-issue state leakage and reproducible results under isolated and reordered execution. Keep evidence tied to exact checkout and actual test invocation.

origin.source: Owner-directed VIB engineering research and independent implementation discussion, 2026-11-25; source-level provenance retained separately.

benefits: Detects hidden coupling and false green results
risks: Random ordering without a recorded seed harms reproducibility; scope to VIB rather than expanding mandatory dependencies

evidence.claim: Existing VIB candidate context only; does not establish implementation or acceptance of this idea.
